title: HTML script, event, URL and foreign-content injection neutralization
attackSurface: Untrusted HTML rendered into a browser document after allowlist sanitization

references.id: Cross Site Scripting Prevention Cheat Sheet

hostile.title: Script element injection
hostile.why: A script tag in rendered HTML executes attacker-controlled JavaScript

hostile.title: Event-handler attribute
hostile.why: Inline event handlers execute attacker-controlled JavaScript

hostile.title: JavaScript URL
hostile.why: A javascript scheme in href executes when the link is activated

hostile.title: Entity-obfuscated JavaScript URL
hostile.why: Character references can obscure a dangerous URL scheme

hostile.title: SVG foreign-content script
hostile.why: Foreign SVG content can carry active markup into HTML

hostile.title: Iframe srcdoc payload
hostile.why: Nested browsing contexts can embed attacker-controlled documents

hostile.title: Unsafe inline style URL
hostile.why: Inline CSS is a separate attack context and is disabled by the strict policy

hostile.title: MathML foreign-content script
hostile.why: MathML foreign content can participate in mutation-XSS parser differentials

benign.title: Paragraph with bold text
benign.why: Simple formatting markup inside the allowlist

benign.title: HTTPS link with title
benign.why: A safe HTTPS link using only allowed attributes

benign.title: Unordered list
benign.why: Basic list markup inside the allowlist

benign.title: Unicode text
benign.why: International text is valid HTML content

benign.title: Relative site link
benign.why: Relative same-site links are safe under the configured policy

benign.title: Escaped comparison text
benign.why: Already canonical escaped text remains unchanged
